hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Traversing down and right in an m x n matrix accumulates cell values via bitwise exclusive-or.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: At each cell (r, c), store the set of reachable exclusive-or values from the start cell.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Compute the union of reachable values from (r - 1, c) and (r, c - 1) combined with grid[r][c].

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Propagates reachable XOR masks across the grid in polynomial time bounded by bit width b.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all C(m+n-2, m-1) grid paths causes exponential explosion.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stores reachable set bit values at each coordinate.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models grid navigation using reachable XOR states.
